Reference / crypto/secret

crypto/secret#

Secret bytes kept out of sight: keys, passwords and shared secrets.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let key = SecretBytes(SystemEntropy().bytes(32));
defer key.close();
key.size();
key.matches(other);                   // constant time

Description#

Secret bytes kept out of sight: keys, passwords and shared secrets.

Printing, comparing or walking an object never shows the bytes; only an explicit export does. close() overwrites them, though copies a caller exported or the engine's collector made may remain.
